text: Happy is the one who has not walked in the advice of the wicked, nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seat of scoffers.
But his delight is in the Torah of ADONAI, and on His Torah he meditates day and night.
He will be like a planted tree over streams of water, producing its fruit during its season. Its leaf never droops — but in all he does, he succeeds.
The wicked are not so. For they are like chaff that the wind blows away.
Therefore the wicked will not stand during the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
For ADONAI knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked leads to ruin.
